title: Foundry Agent Service: search and business API connections
subtitle: 1 / 2  Infrastructure: custom template | Agent, Foundry IQ, Toolbox: Labs 2-4 | Basic Agent Setup / public endpoints
footer: Source review: 2026-09-19 | Live deployment and end-to-end Portal operation unverified. Response paths omitted. See docs/development/architecture.md
notes:
Show Azure AI Search, Foundry IQ, and Travel Ops API and their connections to Foundry Agent Service. Codespaces is outside this diagram. Slide 2 separates participant Azure Portal actions from custom-template internals.
Distinguish template infrastructure from logical features added in Labs 2-4. Prompt Agent contoso-travel-assistant directly searches the policy index in Lab 2. In Lab 3 remove direct search and use knowledge base contoso-travel-knowledge-lab; the paths are not simultaneously enabled. Foundry IQ is a knowledge base on the same Azure AI Search service, with two indexed knowledge sources for policy and approval. Search planning uses gpt-5.5 / Medium. bootstrap_data.py generates initial embeddings through an OpenAI client; this is not a Search-service embedding call.
Lab 4 retains Knowledge and connects Agent to Toolbox using MCP / Project Managed Identity. Only Toolbox to Travel Ops API uses OpenAPI / anonymous HTTPS. The synthetic FastAPI runs on Container Apps and exposes health, per-diem, trip-estimates, and preapprovals. Do not imply direct Agent-to-API access. Tool Search, Skills, Code Interpreter, conditional Web Search internals, evaluation, optimization, and complete RBAC definitions are omitted. Foundry traces go to Application Insights, API environment logs to Log Analytics. GlobalStandard inference is not restricted to Japan East.
Sources: infra/main.bicep; labs/02-prompt-agent.md; labs/03-rag-foundry-iq.md; labs/04-tools-toolbox.md; scripts/create_toolbox.py; scripts/connect_toolbox.py; scripts/bootstrap_data.py; src/travel-api/travel_api/adapters/api/routes.py. This diagram is not evidence of a live deployment.
